mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with declining FEDFUNDS are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of high industrial production growth (above 1.5% annualized), the economy is in an expansion phase that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in nonfarm payrolls and an increase in the unemployment rate signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 600,000 units annually, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening supply chain and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods with rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
